jobs.title: Director, Insights, Innovation & R&D (18-month contract)
jobs.description:
The Director, Insights, Innovation, \& R\&D leads the consumer insight, menu innovation, product development, and food quality agenda for KFC Canada. This role turns consumer and business insight into a growth\-driving innovation pipeline, modernizes KFC's core products, and leads the FIT (Food Innovation \& Technology aka Product Development) team from concept through commercialization. The Director partners closely with Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain and franchisees to ensure products are distinctive, consumer\-led, operationally executable and delivered to KFC quality and food safety standards. If you are a leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, can navigate ambiguity with action, has ambition to deliver impact and a spirit of what is possible – KFC is an environment that will empower and support your success.

  

  

* Own the integrated consumer insights, menu strategy and innovation agenda, translating consumer, category and cultural insight into clear growth opportunities and the short\-, medium\- and long\-term pipeline and business.
* Lead the FIT team and end\-to\-end product development process, from culinary/product brief and prototyping through consumer validation, restaurant testing, commercialization and launch.
* Modernize and continuously improve KFC Canada's core food portfolio, protecting what consumers love while improving taste, quality, consistency, value and relevance.
* Build and deliver a differentiated innovation pipeline that supports the Marketing growth calendar, creates newsworthy reasons to choose KFC and strengthens the brand across priority occasions and consumer groups.
* Act as guardian of KFC Canada's food philosophy and architect of the menu vision, defining the principles, product standards and strategic choices that guide product development and renovation.
* Lead consumer insights across internal resources and agency partners, ensuring customer understanding is embedded in brand strategy, calendar development, innovation, value and broader business planning.
* Set clear innovation learning agendas and stage gates; use consumer, operational and commercial evidence to make fast decisions on what to advance, optimize or stop.
* Partner with Brand, Retail Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and franchisees to ensure innovation is commercially compelling, operationally executable, scalable and supported by strong launch plans.
* Own R\&D prioritization, resources and ways of working, ensuring the team balances core product improvement, calendar innovation, longer\-term pipeline development and rapid test\-and\-learn opportunities.
* Provide leadership oversight of Quality Assurance within the team remit, ensuring robust product and supplier standards, food safety and quality systems, issue escalation, and continuous improvement in partnership with Operations and Supply Chain.
* Deliver credible thought leadership and compelling recommendations to KFC Canada LT, franchisees and cross\-functional stakeholders, aligning the system behind bold but evidence\-based growth choices.
* Build a high\-performing, connected Insights, Innovation, R\&D and QA capability with clear accountability, strong talent development and effective collaboration across the broader business.
  

  

**Education/Certifications**


* Required: Post\-secondary degree in business, marketing, or related discipline
* Preferred: MBA

**Experience**


* 10\+ years of progressive experience across consumer insights, innovation, product development/R\&D, brand, food science or related commercial functions
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and an end\-to\-end food innovation pipeline from insight and concept through product development, testing, commercialization and launch
* Style that inspires and unites cross\-functional teams, bringing clarity in strategy and empowering whilst holding accountable with a spirit of taking people with you.
* Compelling communications capability, translating complex ideas simply to bring clarity and alignment across a diverse set of stakeholders.
* Strong track record of translating consumer insight into commercial growth strategies and high\-impact innovation.
* Strong understanding of operations, supply chain and commercialization requirements; able to balance consumer desirability, operational feasibility and commercial viability.
* Proven ability to modernize core products while building a forward\-looking innovation pipeline.
* Ability to influence senior leaders, franchisees, and complex matrixed stakeholders through ambiguity and transformation.
* Ability to effectively develop and lead high\-performing technical and commercial talent.
* Ability to balance enterprise\-level strategic thinking with curiosity, creativity, pace, and hands\-on problem solving.
* A passion for food, consumers, and emerging trends

**We’d prefer this role to have…**


* Prior experience in QSR, food manufacturing/FMCG, or food retail

**What makes KFC a great place to work?**
**Our People.** We invest in people capability above all else, with a proven track record of developing internal talent to leadership levels across the business both in Canada and globally. We hire and develop people who lead with Smart, Heart and Courage to make a big impact on the business today and grow into leaders of the future.  

**Our Culture.** We are known for a culture that rewards and recognizes bold results and promises everyone a seat at our table. We focus on your personal development as much as your professional development to ensure you can bring your best self to work.  

**Why you’ll love working here**
* Hybrid work model (2–3 days per week in office)
* Paid vacation and personal days, plus 10 paid KFC Canada holidays in addition to statutory holidays.

**Associate Director, Financial Operations**

**Finance Department**

**Hybrid**

**Full Time, Permanent**

**Level 11**

**Requisition Number:** FIN\-2026\-004


Covenant House helps youth ignite their potential and reclaim their lives. As Canada’s largest agency serving youth who are homeless, trafficked or at risk, we offer the widest range of services to hundreds of young people every day.


More than a place to stay, we provide life\-changing care with unconditional love and respect. We meet youth’s immediate needs and then we work together to achieve their future goals. We offer 24/7 crisis shelter transitional housing options on\-site and, in the community, health and well\-being support, training and skill development, and ongoing care once youth move into the community.


For over 40 years, Covenant House has been dedicated to its mission of serving youth on the street and to protect and safeguard all youth with absolute respect and unconditional love. Since 1982, Covenant House has supported more than 100,000 young people.

 **Overview:**

  

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Associate Director, Financial Operations provides operational leadership for Covenant House Toronto’s accounting, payroll, financial reporting, audit, charitable regulatory reporting, internal controls, procurement and financial operations. The role is accountable for accurate, timely and reliable financial information and for sustaining a strong, practical control environment.


This is a hands\-on leadership role for a technically strong accountant who can preserve operational continuity while modernizing financial operations. The Associate Director will lead full\-cycle accounting and procurement, complex payroll oversight, audit readiness and regulatory filings, including the annual CRA T3010 Registered Charity Information Return. The role will also advance the effective use of NetSuite, Power BI and related systems, drawing on Sage experience where relevant to legacy processes and transition requirements. The role is expected to drive the ongoing development of Finance technical and system capabilities, including maintenance, controls, user adoption, process design, reporting enablement and continuous improvement, in collaboration with the Director, Finance \& Analytics and other partners.


As Covenant House Toronto transforms its finance function, the Associate Director will provide full\-cycle people leadership, strengthen leadership capacity, document institutional knowledge, standardize processes and embed scalable controls. Over time, the role will extend a collaborative, risk\-based operational assurance approach across the agency, introducing leading practices without creating unnecessary administrative burden or compromising service to internal partners or youth.

**We are currently recruiting for 1 Full\-time Permanent Associate Director, Finance Operations. This is a replacement position within the organization.**

**Responsibilities:**

**1\. Financial Operations and Full\-Cycle Accounting**

* Lead all aspects of monthly, quarterly and annual close processes, including journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, deferrals, allocations and supporting working papers.
* Ensure the integrity of the general ledger, chart of accounts, financial dimensions and underlying financial data.
* Oversee procurement, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash and banking transactions, fixed assets, restricted and designated funds, and financial recordkeeping.
* Ensure accurate accounting across programs, departments, projects, funding sources and legal or reporting entities, as applicable.
* Prepare and review timely financial statements, schedules and management reports in accordance with applicable accounting standards and organizational policies.
* Maintain clear procedures, accountabilities and service standards for core finance operations.

**2\. Internal Controls, Risk and Operational Assurance**

* Own and continuously strengthen the financial internal control framework, including controls over close, journal entries, reconciliations, payments, revenue, payroll, procurement, cash, banking, system access and segregation of duties.
* Develop a risk\-based program of internal control reviews and operational assurance, beginning with Finance processes and expanding to priority agency processes over time.
* Assess process design and control effectiveness, identify gaps or duplication, document findings and agree practical corrective actions with process owners.
* Partner with operational leaders to introduce scalable leading practices that improve stewardship, consistency and accountability without disrupting business service or creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Apply a service\-oriented approach to controls by considering risk, cost, effort and operational impact when recommending changes.
* Monitor remediation plans and recurring control issues, escalating significant risks appropriately.
* Support enterprise risk management, fraud prevention, policy compliance and protection of organizational assets.

**3\. External Audit and Technical Accounting**

* Lead annual external audit planning and execution, including preparation of audit schedules, working papers, financial statement support and coordination of responses.
* Maintain year\-round audit readiness and high\-quality documentation so that audit requirements are addressed efficiently and accurately.
* Act as a key liaison with external auditors and coordinate management responses and remediation of audit or control findings.
* Research, interpret and apply accounting standards and provide clear recommendations on complex or emerging technical accounting matters.
* Lead implementation of new accounting policies, standards and reporting requirements.
* Support funder, government, compliance and other assurance reviews as required.

jobs.description:
**Join a Challenger**  

  

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  

  

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.  

  

**What's kept us moving?** The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.  

  

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  

  

We can’t wait to get to know you!

 ***The Work***

This role is responsible for overseeing the delivery of cyber security outcomes and driving enterprise\-wide changes in meeting the Organization’s cyber security strategic objectives. This role is responsible for planning, overseeing and organizing resources required to achieve the corporate cyber objectives. This role facilitates the governance, monitoring, communication/escalation and presentation of cyber security roadmap.
### **The Core Responsibilities!**



* Facilitate and support the strategic planning processes for identifying priorities for the cyber security program and articulating the strategy and roadmap.
* Develop budget and financial planning documents and facilitate approvals.
* Oversee assignment of delivery leads or project managers and ensure proper project governance to realize outcomes.
* Financial planning, forecasting and budgeting for the cyber security program.
* Monitor the cyber program execution and delivery.
* Drive complicated and enterprise\-wide initiatives with cyber security impact for the organization and provide Executive reporting.
* Collaborate and negotiate with technology and business leaders to gain support for initiatives and resource needs for program success.
* Ensuring program delivery success by addressing challenges to success and promptly escalating as required.
* Provides leadership and coaching for delivery leads and project managers in gap areas such as financial planning, change management or as required to achieve needed outcomes.
* Measure, monitor and report on benefit realization

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in IT/Cyber, with at least 5 years in leading enterprise programs.
* Proven track record in leading cyber transformation or digital modernization programs.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, and security frameworks.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or TOGAF are a plus.
* Good understanding of accounting and financial management
* Good understanding of benefit realization measurements techniques.
* People \& resource management
* Strategy and Financial Planning
* Process \& capability Management
* Technology Roadmaps
* Ownership \& Accountability

* Good documentation skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Good interpersonal skills, with proven track record of developing relationships and communicating conceptual information effectively to individuals unfamiliar with subject material.
* Strong organizational skills: demonstrated ability to manage time and adhere to tight deadlines.
* Confident, personable, credible professional presence.

jobs.title: VP, AI/Multitech
jobs.description:
**About Us**



Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. We're a proud Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner; Salesforce Crest Partner; Microsoft Gold Certified Partner, and much more: our evolution has taken us well beyond a single platform, making us a multi\-technology advisory and implementation partner across ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, and AI\-driven solutions. What sets us apart is a "technical\-first" approach, teams who understand both business logic and deep system architecture paired with a genuine belief that our people are our greatest strength, and that's who we invest in first.

 **The Opportunity**



As Vice President, AI \& Multitech, you'll position yourself and your team as the technology leaders clients turn to across Appficiency's full platform portfolio \- spanning ERP, CRM, AI, and beyond. This is a role built for someone who thinks in ecosystems, not single platforms: you'll build and coach a team fluent across multiple technologies, shape long\-term account strategy in step with our sales targets, and push AI\-driven delivery efficiency to new heights. You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Sales to shape regional strategy, ensuring the team you build reflects where the business is headed next.

 **What You’ll Do**


* Establish yourself and your team as unbiased, platform\-agnostic technology leaders \- the people clients trust to recommend the right solution, not just the one you know best
* Champion delivery excellence across AI and multitech engagements, ensuring every project lands within scope, on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standard
* Build, train, and coach a team that's genuinely fluent across multiple technology platforms, developing depth and breadth rather than single\-platform specialists
* Make team development a core measure of your own success, growing a bench of multitech\-capable practitioners who can flex across ERP, CRM, and AI engagements
* Shape your team's structure and capacity in step with the company's regional sales strategy, building capability where the business is headed next \- not where it's been
* Cultivate senior\-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic accounts
* Own the long\-term account strategy for key customers, aligning phased delivery plans with Sales' targets and the client's evolving needs
* Partner closely with Sales as a true co\-owner of account growth \- this is one of the most important relationships you'll build in this role
* Push AI\-driven delivery efficiency forward, keeping performance at or above the firm's defined benchmark.

  


**What You’ll Bring**


* A genuine technologist at heart \- deep, hands\-on fluency across ERP and CRM platforms such as NetSuite and Salesforce, with no particular allegiance to either; what matters is credibility across the ecosystem, not expertise in a single tool
* Direct, applied experience with AI and automation technologies \- generative AI tooling, workflow automation platforms, or AI\-driven analytics
* Comfort operating across multiple technical domains simultaneously: ERP, CRM, AI/ML tooling, and productivity platforms, with credibility to speak to each without defaulting to a single specialty
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred; relevant technical certifications (cloud platforms, AI/automation tools, or ERP/CRM\-specific credentials) are a strong plus
* 10\+ years in Professional Services leadership, with 7\-8 of those years hands\-on in systems implementation, integration, or automation\-driven process re\-engineering
* A track record of managing distributed, cross\-platform delivery teams across multiple regions on concurrent projects
* Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including fluency in reading and acting on P\&L statements
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for specific client and regional needs

  


**What Will Set You Apart**

  


* A genuine track record of building multitech delivery teams from the ground up, not just managing existing specialists
* Demonstrated success leading AI\-driven efficiency initiatives with measurable, provable results
* Strong executive presence and credible technical authority that holds up in front of C\-suite stakeholders and skeptical technical audiences alike
* Experience aligning delivery capability with regional sales strategy, building teams ahead of where the business needs them to be
* A career built on breadth across platforms rather than depth in just one \- genuinely multitech, not multitech\-adjacent

  


**What Success Looks Like**


* AI delivery efficiency consistently meets or exceeds the firm's benchmark, with gains visible in client outcomes, not just internal metrics
* Your team is recognized internally and externally as genuinely multitech \- capable across platforms, not siloed by specialty
* Regional team structure evolves in lockstep with the sales vision, so capability is never the bottleneck to growth
* Your partnership with Sales is cited as a model for how Delivery and Sales should work together, with account plans consistently aligned to phased delivery and targets
* Clients see you and your team as the unbiased technology authority they can trust, regardless of which platform the conversation starts with

jobs.title: Director, Digital Experience Platforms
jobs.description:
Embark on a rewarding career with Sobeys Inc., celebrated among Canada’s Top 100 employers where your unique contributions drive success.
  
  

Role Summary
  
The Director, Digital Experience Platforms (DXP) is accountable for the strategy, engineering delivery, operations, reliability, and evolution of all customer\-facing digital experience platforms across Empire banners. This role leads the technology execution of web, mobile, content, search, UX platform capabilities, and front\-end engineering ecosystems, ensuring seamless, scalable, secure, and high\-performing customer experiences.
  
  

The Director serves as the primary technology counterpart to Digital Experience, Digital Product, Customer Engagement, Commerce, and Banner teams, translating business vision into enterprise\-grade digital capabilities. The role is responsible for balancing innovation, delivery velocity, operational excellence, and platform sustainability while enabling a product\-led operating model.
  
  

Accountabilities \& Responsibilities
  
  

Digital Experience Platform Leadership
  
* Own the end\-to\-end technology strategy, roadmap, delivery, and operation of all digital experience platforms across web, mobile, and customer\-facing digital channels.
* Define the future\-state architecture and capability evolution roadmap for DXP technologies including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), front\-end platforms, mobile applications, search technologies, design systems, and supporting digital services.
* Ensure platform capabilities support enterprise digital commerce objectives, customer experience strategies, and banner\-specific priorities.
* Establish technology standards, engineering practices, and governance frameworks for front\-end and customer experience platforms.


Engineering Delivery \& Execution
  
* Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for:
* Customer websites
* Mobile applications
* Front\-end engineering
* Search and discovery platforms
* Design systems
* Content delivery platforms
* AEM ecosystem
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives through Agile product teams.
* Ensure predictable execution, release readiness, and high\-quality software delivery.
* Partner with Product and Business teams to define roadmaps, priorities, and release strategies.
* Govern delivery performance, release quality, technical debt management, and modernization initiatives.


Digital Experience Reliability \& Operations
  
* Own availability, performance, scalability, and resilience of all digital experience platforms.
* Establish operational excellence standards for:
* Incident management
* Production support
* Monitoring and observability
* Disaster recovery
* Capacity planning
* Lead major incident response and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Ensure regulatory, privacy, accessibility, and security compliance requirements are embedded within platform delivery.


UX Technology \& Experience Enablement
  
* Own the technology ecosystem that enables experience delivery, including:
* Design systems
* Component libraries
* Content management capabilities
* Front\-end frameworks
* Partner with UX and CX teams to ensure customer experience strategies are translated into scalable technology solutions.
* Build strong alignment between design intent and engineering execution.
* Enable consistency across banners while balancing local business needs.


Platform Modernization \& Innovation
  
* Champion modern engineering practices including:
* Headless architecture
* API\-first development
* Component\-driven development
* DevOps and CI/CD
* Cloud\-native architecture
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve customer experiences.
* Drive platform simplification and technology rationalization to reduce complexity and improve speed\-to\-market.


Leadership Responsibilities
  
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of managers, architects, Analysts and Developers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, customer obsession, and operational excellence.
* Build succession plans and talent development strategies for key digital capabilities.
* Establish clear ownership and measurable outcomes across engineering and platform teams.
* Create an environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.


Qualifications
  
  

Education
  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* Master's degree considered an asset.


Experience
  
* 12\+ years of progressive experience leading large\-scale digital engineering organizations.
* Proven experience managing customer\-facing digital platforms at enterprise scale.
* Experience leading large Agile product and engineering teams.
* Strong background in digital commerce, customer experience, or omnichannel retail environments.


Technical Expertise
  
* Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
* Headless and composable architectures
* React / Next.js ecosystems
* Mobile application platforms (iOS and Android)
* API and microservices architecture
* Search and discovery technologies
* Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
* DevOps and CI/CD practices
* UX design systems and front\-end architectures

Sobeys is one of Canada’s leading grocery retailers, with more than 1,600 stores across all 10 provinces and banners including Sobeys, Safeway, IGA, Foodland, FreshCo, Thrifty Foods, and Lawtons Drug Stores. Our 128,000 teammates and franchise affiliates are passionate about delivering great food and exceptional experiences to our customers and communities.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Mid-Market Leveraged Finance, Corporate Client Group
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


Reporting into a Senior Director, you will support the Mid\-Market Leveraged Finance (MMLF) team in realization of the Corporate Client Group’s (CCG) objectives through the structuring, delivery and account management of senior leveraged lending relationships principally to Private Equity (PE) owned/backed companies. MMLF is responsible for ensuring adequate legal, accounting, business, and financial due diligence is completed within RBC’s risk appetite to support the extension of leveraged loans, and ongoing monitoring, account management and realization of additional ancillary business for client and sponsor relationships. MMLF is mandated to support loan origination across Canada and within the majority of industries.

**What will you do?**

* Assist in generation, assessment and completion of financings with private equity sponsor owned businesses, and ongoing management and monitoring of the MMLF portfolio
* Develop an understanding of RBC credit appetite and the broad MMLF (and CCG) credit portfolio
* Assist in the preparation of materials for both internal and external purposes (e.g. credit submissions to Group Risk Management (GRM)and presentation materials to support new lending opportunities)
* Perform appropriate due diligence including, but not limited to, identifying and substantiating key risks; developing company specific financial modelling and sensitivity analysis, with focus on understanding cash flows; industry reviews from a variety of sources to provide team with comparable company information and industry insight on trends and areas of opportunity; and PE/sponsor diligence, including investment track record/ returns and partnership with capital providers
* Interact and develop working relationships with other Associates/Associate Directors within CCG and Capital Markets to facilitate deal execution by sharing key practices and transaction experience
* Support CCG Relationship Management team in the preparation and presentation of marketing pitches to existing and potential clients
* Follow up and engage with RBC partners and functions including GRM, Capital Markets, Personal and Commercial Banking, Wealth Management, and others
* Provide research, analysis, and data (market, industry, client, and competitor) to support MMLF advice on the optimal capital structure required to meet strategic objectives with each client relationship
* Provide analysis and support to Managing Director/Senior Director(s)/Director(s), MMLF on risk and return associated with loan transactions and client relationships

**What do you need to succeed?**

**Must\-have**

* Undergraduate degree with a focus in Business, Economics, Mathematics or other problem solving fields
* 2 – 5 years of work experience in a related field, including corporate lending/finance and/or risk management
* Understanding of finance and accounting with the ability to translate concepts to specific transactions
* Ability to model financial sensitivity and scenario worksheets
* Strong collaboration, written and oral communication, analytical and technical skills
* Problem solving skills and comfort working with ambiguity and ability to synthesize various data points/analysis into a defensible position/conclusion

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Graduate degree with a focus in Business, Economics, Mathematics or other problem solving fields
* CPA, CFA or other relevant professional designation – ongoing or completed
* Credit experience
* Strong computer literacy with emphasis on Excel and PowerPoint presentation skills
* Bilingual (French and English) communication skills

**What’s in it for you?**


We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

* Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
* Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high\-performing team
* Opportunities to do challenging work

* A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred; relevant technical certifications (cloud platforms, AI/automation tools, or ERP/CRM\-specific credentials) are a strong plus
* 10\+ years in Professional Services leadership, with 7\-8 of those years hands\-on in systems implementation, integration, or automation\-driven process re\-engineering
* A track record of managing distributed, cross\-platform delivery teams across multiple regions on concurrent projects
* Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including fluency in reading and acting on P\&L statements
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for specific client and regional needs

  


**What Will Set You Apart**

  


* A genuine track record of building multitech delivery teams from the ground up, not just managing existing specialists
* Demonstrated success leading AI\-driven efficiency initiatives with measurable, provable results
* Strong executive presence and credible technical authority that holds up in front of C\-suite stakeholders and skeptical technical audiences alike
* Experience aligning delivery capability with regional sales strategy, building teams ahead of where the business needs them to be
* A career built on breadth across platforms rather than depth in just one \- genuinely multitech, not multitech\-adjacent

  


**What Success Looks Like**


* AI delivery efficiency consistently meets or exceeds the firm's benchmark, with gains visible in client outcomes, not just internal metrics
* Your team is recognized internally and externally as genuinely multitech \- capable across platforms, not siloed by specialty
* Regional team structure evolves in lockstep with the sales vision, so capability is never the bottleneck to growth
* Your partnership with Sales is cited as a model for how Delivery and Sales should work together, with account plans consistently aligned to phased delivery and targets
* Clients see you and your team as the unbiased technology authority they can trust, regardless of which platform the conversation starts with

new_jobs.title: Director, Digital Experience Platforms
new_jobs.description:
Embark on a rewarding career with Sobeys Inc., celebrated among Canada’s Top 100 employers where your unique contributions drive success.
  
  

Role Summary
  
The Director, Digital Experience Platforms (DXP) is accountable for the strategy, engineering delivery, operations, reliability, and evolution of all customer\-facing digital experience platforms across Empire banners. This role leads the technology execution of web, mobile, content, search, UX platform capabilities, and front\-end engineering ecosystems, ensuring seamless, scalable, secure, and high\-performing customer experiences.
  
  

The Director serves as the primary technology counterpart to Digital Experience, Digital Product, Customer Engagement, Commerce, and Banner teams, translating business vision into enterprise\-grade digital capabilities. The role is responsible for balancing innovation, delivery velocity, operational excellence, and platform sustainability while enabling a product\-led operating model.
  
  

Accountabilities \& Responsibilities
  
  

Digital Experience Platform Leadership
  
* Own the end\-to\-end technology strategy, roadmap, delivery, and operation of all digital experience platforms across web, mobile, and customer\-facing digital channels.
* Define the future\-state architecture and capability evolution roadmap for DXP technologies including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), front\-end platforms, mobile applications, search technologies, design systems, and supporting digital services.
* Ensure platform capabilities support enterprise digital commerce objectives, customer experience strategies, and banner\-specific priorities.
* Establish technology standards, engineering practices, and governance frameworks for front\-end and customer experience platforms.


Engineering Delivery \& Execution
  
* Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for:
* Customer websites
* Mobile applications
* Front\-end engineering
* Search and discovery platforms
* Design systems
* Content delivery platforms
* AEM ecosystem
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives through Agile product teams.
* Ensure predictable execution, release readiness, and high\-quality software delivery.
* Partner with Product and Business teams to define roadmaps, priorities, and release strategies.
* Govern delivery performance, release quality, technical debt management, and modernization initiatives.


Digital Experience Reliability \& Operations
  
* Own availability, performance, scalability, and resilience of all digital experience platforms.
* Establish operational excellence standards for:
* Incident management
* Production support
* Monitoring and observability
* Disaster recovery
* Capacity planning
* Lead major incident response and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Ensure regulatory, privacy, accessibility, and security compliance requirements are embedded within platform delivery.


UX Technology \& Experience Enablement
  
* Own the technology ecosystem that enables experience delivery, including:
* Design systems
* Component libraries
* Content management capabilities
* Front\-end frameworks
* Partner with UX and CX teams to ensure customer experience strategies are translated into scalable technology solutions.
* Build strong alignment between design intent and engineering execution.
* Enable consistency across banners while balancing local business needs.


Platform Modernization \& Innovation
  
* Champion modern engineering practices including:
* Headless architecture
* API\-first development
* Component\-driven development
* DevOps and CI/CD
* Cloud\-native architecture
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve customer experiences.
* Drive platform simplification and technology rationalization to reduce complexity and improve speed\-to\-market.


Leadership Responsibilities
  
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of managers, architects, Analysts and Developers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, customer obsession, and operational excellence.
* Build succession plans and talent development strategies for key digital capabilities.
* Establish clear ownership and measurable outcomes across engineering and platform teams.
* Create an environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.


Qualifications
  
  

Education
  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* Master's degree considered an asset.


Experience
  
* 12\+ years of progressive experience leading large\-scale digital engineering organizations.
* Proven experience managing customer\-facing digital platforms at enterprise scale.
* Experience leading large Agile product and engineering teams.
* Strong background in digital commerce, customer experience, or omnichannel retail environments.


Technical Expertise
  
* Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
* Headless and composable architectures
* React / Next.js ecosystems
* Mobile application platforms (iOS and Android)
* API and microservices architecture
* Search and discovery technologies
* Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
* DevOps and CI/CD practices
* UX design systems and front\-end architectures

Sobeys is one of Canada’s leading grocery retailers, with more than 1,600 stores across all 10 provinces and banners including Sobeys, Safeway, IGA, Foodland, FreshCo, Thrifty Foods, and Lawtons Drug Stores. Our 128,000 teammates and franchise affiliates are passionate about delivering great food and exceptional experiences to our customers and communities.

Who We Are \| Why Work With Us
